label: D1-only, sparse within D1; stronger after runs of unrewarded trials
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass; never at GO or D2), but on just ~12% of D1 steps, and no predicate picks out which ones. Rates go up with an unrewarded previous trial (5.1% vs 3.2% of steps), low model value (none above 8.1), a moderately a1-leaning policy logit, previous choice a1, late episode trials (90-99: 1.7x) and D1 fixation errors. The strongest windows are streaks of 2-3 unrewarded trials, often while the agent keeps choosing the bad option just before it switches. The best coherent predicate (D1 and the last two trials both unrewarded; it uses only observed rewards) reaches dev F1 0.30, P 0.37, R 0.25. Its coverage grows with activation quartile (0.13 to 0.38), so unrewarded streaks raise magnitude but do not decide whether it fires. The feature still fires after rewarded trials (47% of mass). Phase alone has F1 0.21. Value thresholds and policy-logit predicates scored F1 0.22-0.27. The recorded predicate is the best-scoring one, kept as a partial description.
